class.name: PlayerState
class.brief_description: Per-player data everyone is meant to see: name, id, score, ping.
class.description: A child of the [GameStateBase], not of the [PlayerController], and that is the whole point of the class. A [PlayerController] exists only on the server and on its owning client; a [PlayerState] has to be visible to every peer, so it lives on the node that exists everywhere. Created when a player logs in, from [member GameModeBase.player_state_scene] if one is set. [member player_id] is handed out by the server and is unique for the session - it is what names this player's controller and pawn on every peer, while [member unique_id] is the connection they are on. Extend it in GDScript for anything the scoreboard needs and return the property names from [code]_get_replicated_properties[/code]; the framework keeps them in step with the server's copy.

members.member: Whether this player is at this machine. Always [code]true[/code] without networking.
Always [code]0[/code] without networking. The field exists so UI written today keeps working once replication fills it in.
Matches [member LocalPlayer.player_index] for a local player.
The multiplayer peer id once there is networking. [code]1[/code] is the server, which is also what a purely local game reports.
